name: labels-discovery-b
approved: Drafted overnight Nov 5–6 2026 by Claude from a line-by-line check against the Gemara and Rashi on Sefaria (each finding re-checked before applying); David asked for fixes to go live overnight. Awaiting review by a rav.

repairs.why: Second half of אביי's statement that begins on 12a (נקטינן הלכות מועד כהלכות שבת ... יש מהן פטור אבל אסור). Not where a discussion lands; the second half takes the first half's label (12a step 31 is מימרא).
repairs.source: Moed Katan 12a-b: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי נָקְטִינַן הִלְכוֹת מוֹעֵד כְּהִלְכוֹת שַׁבָּת ... יֵשׁ מֵהֶן פָּטוּר אֲבָל אָסוּר

repairs.why: אביי cursing רב's ruling is an opposing statement, not the pushing aside of a proof. Nothing here is a proof.

Second half of the challenge that ends 29b (אלא לרבי ... מאי איכא למימר): 'but he is still under his father's authority!' is an objection, not the pushing aside of a proof. 29b steps 12-13 are already קשיא.

First half of a הניחא ... אלא challenge (הניחא לרבי יוסי ברבי יהודה ... אלא לרבי מאי איכא למימר); step 5 is its second half. It follows a קשיא, not a שאלה, so תשובה cannot stand. The same construction on 29b (steps 12-13) is labelled קשיא, קשיא.
repairs.source: Nazir 30a: הָנִיחָא לְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה

repairs.why: The ברייתא (טוב אשר לא תדור) is the source of step 10's difficulty: it shows neither רבי מאיר nor רבי יהודה distinguishes vow from gift. A source quoted to attack is a Challenge, never a Proof.
repairs.source: Nedarim 9a: דְּתַנְיָא טוֹב אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִדֹּר

repairs.why: 'ריחני' is the answer to 51b's last step (ולבני מערבא ... לאתויי מאי? לאתויי ריחני), which is labelled קשיא. It is the second half of an answer, not a conclusion. (If 51b step 30 is ever relabelled שאלה, like its twin step 28, this should be תשובה.)
רב כהנא brings the story of רבי ישמעאל's daughter to stop his colleagues' plan to rule like רבי יהודה. A source brought against a plan is a Challenge, not a Proof.
repairs.source: Niddah 52a: אֲמַר לְהוּ רַב כָּהֲנָא לֹא כָּךְ הָיָה מַעֲשֶׂה

repairs.why: Continuation of the same story רב כהנא quotes against the plan (rule 1: every step quoting the rest of the attacking source is קשיא).
repairs.source: Niddah 52a: אָמְרוּ דָּבָר שֶׁאָמַר אוֹתוֹ צַדִּיק

repairs.why: The vote (נמנו וגמרו) is the end of רב כהנא's precedent and is the point that defeats the plan; same source as step 14.
Continues רבא's statement, which step 31 quotes (ואמר רבא) to attack two hairs in one follicle. Rule 1: the rest of the attacking source is also קשיא.
Same as step 32: the second half of רבא's statement, quoted inside the challenge.
End of the Tosefta that רבא quotes on 15a to object to רב נחמן (15a steps 13-16 are all קשיא). The second half takes the first half's label.
repairs.source: Pesachim 15b: הַפִּיגּוּל וְהַנּוֹתָר וְהַטָּמֵא בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים

repairs.why: No challenge comes before it. It is the Gemara's own comment on why the verse in step 1 is excluded, even though רב נחמן read it hopefully.
repairs.source: Rosh Hashanah 32b: וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּאָמַר רַב נַחְמָן ... אַדְכּוֹרֵי רִיתְחָא בְּרֵישׁ שַׁתָּא לָא מַדְכְּרִינַן

repairs.why: The rest of the ברייתא רב הונא brings (תא שמע) to answer the challenge in step 24. Step 25 is תירוץ; the second half takes the first half's label.
repairs.source: Rosh Hashanah 32b: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם ... מַלְכוּת דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יוֹסֵי

repairs.why: The second half of רבא's objection (step 7, ולטעמיך) to רמי בר חמא's reasoning, which answered the question in step 5. An objection to an answer is a Challenge.
Continuation of the attacking ברייתא brought with והתניא (steps 5 and 7, already קשיא in the data); the middle step must match.
Continuation of the משנה that 3b step 15 (תשובה) quotes as רבי יוחנן's source (אלא סתמא אשכח). The second half takes the first half's label.
repairs.source: Shevuot 4a: אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא אַחַת. זוֹ הִיא שְׁבוּעַת בִּיטּוּי

repairs.why: Objections (אי הכי ... ותו ... ותו) to the answer of steps 11-13 that the משנה is about lashes. An objection to an answer is a Challenge; it is answered by רב יוסף in step 15.
repairs.source: Shevuot 4a: אִי הָכִי שְׁתַּיִם שֶׁהֵן אַרְבַּע

repairs.find: brings three proofs from the משנה that it cannot be about lashes
repairs.replace: raises three objections from the משנה showing it cannot be about lashes
repairs.why: Summary calls the objections 'proofs'.
רב כהנא clarifies how to understand רב יוסף's answer; no proof is pushed aside. It is the first half of the statement that step 17 finishes (מימרא).
repairs.source: Shevuot 4a: לָא תֵּימָא רַבִּי נָסֵיב לַהּ אַלִּיבָּא דְתַנָּאֵי

repairs.why: Continuation of רבי יוחנן's statement quoted with אִינִי? וְהָאָמַר to attack the ברייתא (step 16). Rule 1: the rest of the attacking source is also קשיא.
Same: the second story is part of the same attacking statement; answered in step 19.
Second half of רב's דרשה, quoted in step 23 (ראיה) to support רבי אבא. The second half takes the first half's label.
Second half of a two-sided analysis (מאן דאמר קוצר ... מאן דאמר בוצר ...), and step 14 continues the discussion. It is not a conclusion.
repairs.source: Sukkah 13b: מַאן דְּאָמַר בּוֹצֵר שֶׁאֵין לוֹ יָדוֹת

repairs.why: End of אביי and רבא's answer that begins on 25b (step 30 תשובה): one says הלל only on a full stomach.
repairs.source: Taanit 25b-26a: לְפִי שֶׁאֵין אוֹמְרִים הַלֵּל אֶלָּא עַל נֶפֶשׁ שְׂבֵעָה

repairs.why: In a story, the king objects to the elders' answer. Rejection is only for pushing aside a proof; an objection to an answer is a Challenge.
Matches the new label.
A line of the story in the middle of the episode (the king's next request follows at once). No Conclusion in the middle; story lines are Statement.
repairs.source: Tamid 32a: מִיָּד אַלְבֵּישׁ יָתְהוֹן לְבוּשִׁין דְּאַרְגְּווֹן

repairs.why: The king states a plan ('I want to go to אפריקי'); nothing is asked.
The elders object to the king's plan ('you cannot go'). With no question before it, it cannot be a Response; an objection to a plan in a story is a Challenge.
End of the ברייתא that רבא quotes (תא שמע) in step 12 (ראיה); step 14 draws the inference. The second half takes the first half's label.
repairs.source: Temurah 2b: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּכוּלָּן אֲנִי רוֹאֶה לְהַחְמִיר

repairs.why: End of the ברייתא's answer on 70b (מאי טעמא בא? להוציא כף ומחתה, שכל הפרשה ...), which is labelled תשובה (70b step 29).
repairs.source: Yoma 71a: שֶׁכׇּל הַפָּרָשָׁה כּוּלָּהּ נֶאֶמְרָה עַל הַסֵּדֶר

repairs.why: Second half of רב חסדא's answer (step 3, תשובה): the reasoning that applies the tradition. Not a separate supporting source.
אדרבה pushes back on אביי's answer (step 13, תירוץ) to the challenge of step 12. An objection to an answer is a Challenge; step 15 answers it (תירוץ).
Matches the new label; step 13 is an answer.
רבא's alternative answer to the challenge of step 12 (why change the verses and not the משנה), parallel to אביי's answer in step 13 (תירוץ).
repairs.source: Yoma 71a: רָבָא אָמַר אָמַר קְרָא יׇעֳמַד חַי

repairs.why: Title should not name the step a proof once it is a Resolution.

repairs.find: Gives an independent proof for the same point
repairs.replace: Gives an independent answer for the same point
repairs.why: Matches the new label.

Inside the ברייתא that answers מנהני מילי (step 26); 'יכול ... תלמוד לומר' is a midrashic limit, not the pushing aside of a proof. The second half of the answer takes the first half's label (step 27, תשובה).
repairs.source: Zevachim 93b: יָכוֹל שֶׁאֲנִי מְרַבֶּה עוֹר עַד שֶׁלֹּא הוּפְשַׁט
